# Broad Protein learner ranges; native training budget fixed at 500M.
# QD snapshots the fixed settings above and uses profiles/qd.ini reward ranges.
# Trial 0 is terminal-only; other trials test modest auxiliary rewards.
# Fixed bounds override inherited sweep dimensions from default.ini.
# root_money compares fresh-start cash, not reset-bank starting wealth or rewards.
# This is a training metric, not a held-out leaderboard evaluation.
